option_relations.rationale: Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa (DEB) is a broader category that includes Recessive Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa (RDEB) with revertant mosaicism.
Recessive Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa (RDEB) is a broader category that includes RDEB with revertant mosaicism.
Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa with Revertant Mosaicism is a broader category that includes the specific presentation of RDEB with revertant mosaicism as a chronic non-healing ulcer.

The option 'Severe generalized recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (RDEB) with revertant mosaicism' is clinically equivalent to 'Recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (RDEB) with revertant mosaicism, presenting as a chronic non-healing ulcer' given the context of the severe, chronic ulcer and the genetic findings.
